output.summary: The claim was denied because prior authorization was not obtained. To move forward, the policyholder must submit a physician’s medical necessity letter and a retroactive authorization request as required by clause C-2026-MRI-PREAUTH.

items.text: Provide a physician’s letter of medical necessity supporting the outpatient MRI.
Submit a retroactive authorization request for the MRI service.
Gather the physician’s letter and complete the retroactive authorization form, then forward both to the Plan’s prior‑authorization department per clause 4.2.
